From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Parking-lot questions for Acme architecture session (Fri 13 Mar)

Folks — forwarding the Acme thread and dropping the initial parking-lot questions we've collected so far. Please review and mark owners; we should be ready to answer live or follow up within 48 hours after the session.

From Acme: performance expectations around long multi-turn sessions and whether prefix/KV caching will reduce cost without increasing tail latency. Also questions on dedicated vs private networking for PII workloads and any audit/logging footprint (they called out SOC2 evidence).

Parking-lot questions (pre-session):
- KV cache: behavior for long-running sessions (1000+ tokens). Does cache growth impact eviction and tail latency? Owner: Dylan
- Batching & latency: expected latency delta when using continuous batching for short bursts vs steady throughput. Owner: Dylan
- Quantization: any recommended quant profiles for Acme's LLMs (they use 8-bit mixed quantized weights). Owner: Marissa (coordinate with research)
- Deployment options: brief pros/cons matrix Dedicated vs Private for PII + network egress considerations. Owner: Laura
- SOC2/audit: what artifacts do we provide by default (audit logs, admin access logs, retention). Owner: Laura/Marissa

Action items before Fri:
1) Dylan — bubble up any benchmark snippets or sim results you can share (even high-level numbers) for KV cache at long sequences.
2) Marissa — confirm quant profiles and whether we have a recommended default config for 8-bit models.
3) Laura — prepare the Dedicated vs Private one-pager and list of SOC2 artifacts.

Attachments: none (we'll use agenda.pdf & infra-diagram in the invite).

Thanks — I'll take notes during the session and capture any new parking-lot items to loop back.

Laura
